newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Oct 25.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The foreign trade deficit reached 110.7 billion crowns in September, an increase of over 77 percent from the same period a year ago. September alone contributed 10.5 billion crowns to the total.
- The Ministry of Finance has set the price at which CEZ can sell electricity to the eight regional power companies at 1,035 crowns per megawatthour, an increase of 0.2 percent.

- The Czech National Bank's programme to stabilise small banks should not have a significant effect on monetary reserves or on the rate of inflation, according to the general manager of Kreditni Banka, Vladimir Sulc.
- The Ministry of the Interior intends to increase control over foreigners living and working in the Czech Republic, which currently number 186,000.
- Vsetinska Zbrojovka a.s. obtained a state order worth one billion crowns for weaponry to be mounted on L-159 aircraft.
- Ceske Drahy, the Czech railways concern, has signed a contract to purchase 26 new second-class passenger cars from Austria's SGP, part of Siemens AG. The order is worth one billion crowns.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - Komercni Banka has decided to lower its mortgage rates in November, though the rate has yet to be set.

- Kovohute Bridlicna intends to open a joint venture with Russia's SamWein for the production of food packaging materials. Kovohute Bridlicna will own 55 percent of the joint venture and invest several tens of millions of crowns.
PRAVO - Zemska Banka has decided to participate in the state's programme for strengthening small banks.

- ETA Hlinsko a.s. increased its productivity by 22 percent in the first three quarters of this year. Sales increased by 9.4 percent or 157 million crowns with an average of 3,904 employees, 450 less than last year.
